flags.why: This literary and traditional-medical term is not an ordinary conversational word for a child.

Modern Vietnamese hospitals call the paediatrics ward khoa nhi, while tiểu nhi occurs in contexts such as [traditional medicine](https://dongythoxuanduong.com.vn/tintuc/nhung-bai-thuoc-chua-tre-em-cam-tich/vi-VN-10825-225.aspx).
flags.fix: Bài thuốc này dùng để chữa ho ở tiểu nhi. = This traditional remedy is used to treat coughs in children.

flags.fix: He opened a small shop at the beginning of the street.
